A story that invites relationship claims, 26 real turns at extraction cadence 2, so consolidation (boundaries 10 and 20) and the hall -> vault scene break both run. Step 0 (L6): every sync reports ran/skipped/live (memoryMirror summary), recorded after boundaries 10, 20 and the last. PASS needs the mirror book to exist and hold >= 1 enabled so_ entry. PREDECLARED (never retuned): the strip rule (median rate >= 0.8) applies only when >= 5 so_ entries were each eligible in >= 20 loud generations; otherwise the verdict is UNMEASURABLE with the counts and nothing changes. The record names the gating mode and the read route; run it in scan mode (L1) for the rate that ships, and once in file mode as the U6 comparison.

import_story.title: SO-V25-08 Mirror Rate
import_story.description: v2.5 plan 08 L6: a story built to invite relationship claims (trust, debts, family, betrayal) among a small cast, so the memory mirror has relationship rows to write and the evidence ring has keyed entries to tally.

qualities.rubric: Where is the party now: the guild hall or the vault beneath the city?

checkpoints.name: The guild hall
checkpoints.objective: Learn who owes whom, and who can be trusted.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: true, cadence: 2 }); const ev = globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence; if (!ev) throw new Error('no evidence ring on this build'); const settings = rt.getGlobalSettings(); globalThis.__soL6 = { chatId: SillyTavern.getContext().getCurrentChatId(), gatingMode: settings.worldInfo?.gatingMode ?? null, routes: { fallback: settings.extraction?.profileId ?? null, read: settings.extraction?.profiles?.read ?? null, synthesis: settings.extraction?.profiles?.synthesis ?? null }, syncs: [] }; return globalThis.__soL6;

send_generate.text: We reach the moonlit hall. I tell Arin I trust him with my life after he pulled me out of the river last winter.
Arin admits he still owes the guild master a debt, and I promise to help him pay it off.
I ask the DM Narrator what the guards think of Arin; they call him my sworn shield.
Arin and I argue about the map, but he apologises and we shake hands like brothers.
I tell Arin that Mara the smith is my cousin and that she forged his blade.
Arin says he has never forgiven Captain Voss for abandoning him at the border.
I thank Arin for guarding my back and swear I will never leave him behind either.
We meet Mara at her forge; she greets Arin warmly and scolds me for not writing.
Captain Voss arrives and sneers at Arin; I step between them and defend my friend.
Mara quietly tells me she distrusts Captain Voss and that he owes her silver.

send_generate.text: Arin confesses he is afraid Voss will expose his past to the guild.
I promise Arin that whatever Voss knows, I will stand with him before the guild.
We leave the hall and head down into the vault beneath the city, Arin leading with a torch.
In the vault Arin finds a letter from Voss to the guild master naming Arin a deserter.
I burn the letter and tell Arin his secret is safe with me.
Mara follows us into the vault and admits she has been working for Voss all along.
Arin feels betrayed by Mara; I try to make peace between them.
Mara begs Arin for forgiveness and offers him her family's ring as a pledge.
Arin accepts the ring and says Mara is family again, but he will not forget.
Captain Voss corners us in the vault; Arin tells him their old friendship is over.

send_generate.text: I remind Voss that he still owes Mara silver and that the guild will hear of it.
Voss backs down and swears he will leave Arin alone if we keep quiet.
Back in the hall, Arin tells the guild master he is proud to call me his partner.
Mara and Arin share a drink and talk about the years they lost to Voss's lies.
I ask Arin whether he still trusts Mara; he says he trusts her because I do.
We toast to the three of us: Arin, Mara and me, bound by what happened in the vault.
